features.quote: Hardcap at $N=40$ turns to prevent runaway API costs, or until the model hallucinates/refuses to continue.

Only feed the model its original system prompt, the original task, and the last 3 Turns (Code + Error). This guarantees that any breakdown is due to the *psychology of the prompt/failure loop*, not token saturation.
